description:
This release makes a number of improvements to the FriendNet client and server, including new features for both.

This release was done in collaboration with a new contributor, @vwxi. I want to thank him for working with me on many features in this release.

Changes:
 - Added the ability to search all connected servers at once
 - Fixed some file browser sizing issues
 - Fixed connecting to yourself using the network
 - Added quick relay fallback for some kinds of actions to improve latency
 - Direct connections to use are now sorted by lowest latency
 - Added external authentication for servers (see: friendnet.org/docs/server/external-authentication)
 - Removed the need for HTTPS on the web UI (root is no longer needed because a certificate no longer needs to be installed!)
 - Added the ability to do keyword blocking for search serverside (see: friendnet.org/docs/server/search-filtering/)
 - Added AppImage builds for Linux

I'm very excited to work on the next release, which will be bigger than this one.
